neighbours.label: an artificial, enclosed setting as opposed to the open outdoors (treadmill, gym, pool, tanks, indoors, captivity)
fire: When it rains, the runners use a treadmill at the club.
The salmon are farmed in pens and tanks rather than caught wild.
The kids moved the game inside when the storm came.
The orchids only survive indoors in this cold climate.
The tigers were raised in captivity at a private zoo.
She practiced her dives at an indoor pool all winter.
The seedlings started in a heated greenhouse behind the shed.
The boxers stay fit in a gym during the rainy months.
quiet: When it rains, the runners splash along the muddy trail.
The salmon are caught wild in the cold northern rivers.
The kids kept playing in the field when the storm came.
The orchids grow wild on the cliffs in this warm climate.
The tigers hunted at dusk in the forest of the north.
She practiced her dives in the open sea all summer.
The seedlings sprouted on a sunny slope behind the barn.
The boxers run on the beach during the dry months.

notes: Output: the + direction promotes ' outside', ' real' and suppresses ' indoor', ' artificial', so this pole is the indoor side of an indoor/outdoor distinction. Probe of ' greenhouse' sat just under 0.20.
